name: Adaptive Asset Allocation - Bond Universe + 8% Vol Target
description: Adaptive Asset Allocation (6-month momentum screen + min-variance optimization within top bonds) applied to the fixed-income universe (US Treasuries, USD-hedged global aggregate, global high yield, EUR govt bonds, India INR govt bonds), then scaled to 8% annualised volatility target. Combines regime-responsive bond selection within fixed-income markets with volatility control.
